population: Potential itch.io first-game launch traffic and 2014/2019 owner analytics capabilities; not an observed 2026 sales sample
unit: Acquisition channel mechanism and measurement contract; channel volumes/costs and orders remain unknown
period: Historically documented 2014/2019 referrer features, 2025 self-selected page-view survey, creator guidance checked 2026-10-27

channels.attribution_evidence: Owner impressions/clicks where available or public search listing observation
channels.measurement_limit: Rank/exposure alone does not show visitors or sales

channels.attribution_evidence: Verified referred-domain view events where browser passes a referrer
channels.measurement_limit: Referrer stripping and search result personalization; no native paid-vs-organic search split proved

channels.surface: Offsite social posts, forum communities and creators
channels.attribution_evidence: Attributed external referral URL/domain with known campaign when present
channels.measurement_limit: Same social domain can contain organic posts, paid ads and influencer mentions

channels.surface: Opted-in itch.io follower email/feed and external permissioned newsletters
channels.attribution_evidence: Documented follower notifications; delivery/open/click and external newsletter sources require independent authorized records
channels.measurement_limit: Follower count is not delivered email, unique visitor or paid buyer

channels.attribution_evidence: Attributed coverage URL if independently identified; generic domain alone cannot prove a specific influencer campaign
channels.measurement_limit: No controlled causal effect, attributed game profit or buyer identity

channels.surface: Off-platform search/social advertisements or sponsored referrals
channels.attribution_evidence: Owner-collected campaign spend plus stable campaign-tagged visits/orders only if authorization and end-to-end tracking exist
channels.measurement_limit: No native itch.io paid-placement product, click-through receipts or ad profitability is verified here

comparison_scope: documented mechanisms, identifiable source categories, attribution evidence quality, and required money/time/denominator fields, not performance ranking
limitations: Available 2014 and 2019 analytics capabilities are historical and might not exactly match the current 2026 account UI.
Payment-referrer, click, impression, browser-play and unique buyer are distinct units.
External paid advertising may be purchased from third parties, but no particular ad platform's integration or performance is established.
Self-selected 2025 traffic survey respondents do not identify representative paid-seller channel yields.
